ja: あの時、部長はもう帰ってたよ。
en: The boss had already gone home.
alternatives: The boss had left for the day.
The manager had already gone home.
point: その時点より前の出来事は had + 過去分詞

ja: 今日は五時に上がります。
alternatives: I'm going home at five today.
I'm heading out at five today.
point: 決まった予定は進行形で言える

ja: 先週の金曜は休んだよ。
alternatives: I took a day off last Friday.
point: 休みを取るは take ~ off

ja: ちょうど君の話をしてたんだ。
en: We were just talking about you.
point: その時していた最中の動作は過去進行形

ja: プリンターが壊れてると思う。
alternatives: I think the printer has broken down.
I think the printer isn't working.
point: I think の後ろに文をそのまま続ける

ja: 時間があれば手伝うのに。
en: If I had time, I'd help.
alternatives: I'd help if I had time.
If I weren't so busy, I'd help.
point: 現実と違う仮定は if + 過去形、主節は would
